automatable_note: A jumper cable must be plugged into the ESC socket before power-up and pulled after the first tone sequence. The bench cannot do this.

manual.action: Plug the jumper cable onto the ESC.
Pull the jumper cable off after the cell-count tones, within 10 s of power-up.
manual.action_de: Jumperkabel nach den Zellentönen abziehen, innerhalb 10 s nach dem Einschalten.

entry.confirm_signal: Ascending three-tone sequence plus cell-count tones at power-up; descending three-tone sequence when the jumper is pulled.
steps: Transmitter on, throttle at motor-off (0 %). Connect the ESC master cable to the receiver throttle channel; receiver on.
Operator: plug in the jumper cable.
Connect the motor. Apply drive power.
The ESC sounds an ascending three-tone sequence and single tones for the detected cell count (long tone = 4 cells, short tone = 1 cell). The LED flashes.
Operator: pull the jumper cable. The ESC sounds a descending three-tone sequence.
The ESC sounds mode series 1, 2, 3 ... one tone more per series; the LED flashes the same count.
Move the throttle to full (100 %) after the wanted tone count.

The ESC confirms with an ascending three-tone sequence and the mode as tones. Mode 2: a further stick position can then be set. Mode 6: move the stick to reverse (0 %) after the full-throttle confirmation.
Wait for the confirmation before disconnecting power; otherwise the ESC treats programming as incomplete and locks (9 LED flashes).

announce.description: The ESC sounds mode 1 as one tone, mode 2 as two tones, and so on, one series after another with a pause between series.

select.description: Move the throttle to 100 % when the series of the wanted mode sounds.

skip.description: No skip. Disconnecting power before the confirmation locks the ESC.

scheme.confirm_signal: Ascending three-tone sequence, then the mode as single tones.
scheme.exit: Wait for the confirmation, then disconnect drive power (the manual says to wait a short moment).
scheme.description: Throttle at 0 %, jumper cable plugged in, apply power, pull the jumper cable. The ESC counts modes as single tones. Full throttle at the wanted count stores the mode. Mode 10 then runs a BEC voltage stage.

values.name: Glider, ESC operation with EMK brake (default strength 92 %), optional separate motor-off position
Motor plane, ESC operation, no brake
Helicopter governor with autorotation (AR on at 25 % throttle)
Forward / reverse, motor-off at stick centre

unknowns: Duration of one tone in ms is not stated.
Gap between tones inside one mode series in ms is not stated.
Pause between two mode series in ms is not stated.
Whether the mode series loops until a mode is selected is not stated.
Time window in ms for moving the throttle to full after the wanted series is not stated.
Duration in ms of the three-tone sequences (ascending and descending) is not stated.
Input voltage range and rated current of the 80+ HV and 120+ HV are not given in the manual (only the update step mentions a 20 to 50 V battery).
Tone count of the BEC stage is derived from the 0.2 V per tone rule; the manual does not list a table.
Item number 2 is an index chosen here.
notes: Modes 1 to 6 can only be set by mode programming, not with the programming unit, per the manual.
Mode 4 on this ESC always includes autorotation; the manual states it cannot be programmed with or without AR.
The jumper cable is pulled within 10 s of initialisation (Kontronik_Jive_Pro.pdf p.11 DE, p.22 EN).
